tiles.name: Willis Tower
tiles.blurb: Chicago's black skyscraper, formerly the Sears Tower, with glass boxes on its sky deck.

tiles.name: Taipei 101
tiles.blurb: Taiwan's bamboo-shaped skyscraper, the world's tallest from 2004 to 2010.

tiles.name: CN Tower
tiles.blurb: Toronto's needle-like tower, the world's tallest freestanding structure for over 30 years.

tiles.name: Burj Khalifa
tiles.blurb: Dubai's needle-like skyscraper, the tallest building in the world since 2010.

tiles.name: El Capitan
tiles.blurb: Yosemite's giant granite wall, a climbing legend, scaled with no ropes in 2017.

tiles.name: Mount Everest
tiles.blurb: The highest mountain on Earth, first climbed by Edmund Hillary and Tenzing Norgay in 1953.
